summary: Complete e2e testing of DrON Topografía - Cronograma Import and Activity Types Detection. All 13 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified dashboard metrics, project details, and cronograma import modal work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Excel parser correctly detects activity types (pilas, muros, anclas, excavacion) from keywords
Project creation from cronograma saves actividades_tipo and all metrics correctly
Dashboard conditionally shows Pilas/Muros/Anclas metrics only when project has those types configured
Cronograma import modal has proper file upload area and template download link
seed_data_creation: Test Excel file exists at /app/backend/uploads/cronograma_tipos_test.xlsx with sample activities for pilas, muros, anclas, excavacion
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cronograma import functionality fully tested. The Excel parser in /app/backend/services/cronograma_ai.py correctly detects activity types based on keywords. The /api/proyectos/crear-desde-cronograma endpoint saves actividades_tipo, pilas_planeadas, muros_planeados, anclas_planeadas, and volumen_total_planeado. The DashboardView component conditionally renders Pilas/Muros/Anclas metrics only when the project has those types in actividades_tipo array.
